_doc: Demo-only markers searched by scan.mjs --rule demo (P4 architecture §6; a hard gate since T-P4-07). Bundle part: the top-level *.js and *.css listed in ui/dist/app/build-manifest.json, or the in-memory bundle for build.mjs --check. Taken from the 'demo code to delete' tables of 映射_core §7, 映射_overview §5, 映射_tiers §13, 映射_logs §6, 映射_settings §6. text: literal substrings (JS); regex: JS patterns that survive minification (property names, string literals); css_classes: class/id tokens (ov-demo and logs-demo are element ids) searched as whole tokens in JS and, in CSS, as .name / #name selectors and [id=name] / [class~=name] attribute selectors — the CSS move into css/design.css is driven by this list; css_text: literal substrings searched in the CSS bundle; message_ids: prototype-explanation message ids, added by the 04 series once the strings are extracted. source: what is banned in the sources the app target is built from (T-P4-07 requirement 2): every *.js under ui/src and src/index.html (comments included) except src/design/ and src/i18n/locales/, and every *.css under ui/css except css/design.css (class tokens as selectors with comments skipped; text such as @i18n-pending anywhere). The app entry's import graph must not reach src/design/. JS (bundle and sources) is matched after decoding \uXXXX / \u{...} escapes, so a CJK marker or a message id inside a locale chunk (a catalog string inside a string) is seen (T-P4-07 fix round 1). message_ids are id prefixes: overview.demo. and shell.demo. were deleted from the catalog with the demo controls (design/demo.js uses design-time literals); they must not come back. source.design_only: hook files outside src/design/ that only the design entry imports (P4 architecture §1.1.1), exempt from the source markers by name with a reason; the gate fails if the app entry reaches one of them.

design_only.reason: The design target runtime hook (fixture mode / sim mode, P4 architecture §1.1.1): it starts the prototype simulator, so it names T.sim and sim: by design. Imported by src/entry/design.js only.
The design target data hook: imports design/data.js and design/demo.js (the demo controls). Imported by src/entry/design.js only.
Design-only odds and ends run last in the design entry (?lang handling, sim bookkeeping). Imported by src/entry/design.js only.
The design target entry: imports the design hooks above. Never imported by the app entry.
